# Bid the yards and the forms, not the square footage.

> Price a concrete driveway, patio, or slab from cubic yards, form footage, finish labor, and access — not a flat price per square foot. See yards to order, price per yard, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
